scope: Independent S5 harness check before r02; not final S5 or TC-24 acceptance

findings_fixed.issue: HTTP heartbeat required runtime_id, which DaemonHeartbeat intentionally omits. Every genuine successful heartbeat was classified invalid_ack; fake positives invented the field.
findings_fixed.fix: Validate HTTP status 200 and body.status==ok; retain runtime_gone refusal. Runtime identity stays bound to the owner credential, request runtime_id and subsequent authoritative owner runtime-list read. All fake HTTP success ACKs use the actual shape.

findings_fixed.issue: Writeback only recorded open_sockets; 99 sockets with failed reconnect still allowed all 101 runs and pass=true.
findings_fixed.authorization: Parent explicitly approved minimal semantic correction on 2026-11-14 before edits.
findings_fixed.fix: Require exactly 100 open observers at the boundary and before trigger. Freeze existing socket_id/connections/closed_ms; any mid-run loss or replacement invalidates both metrics and aborts remaining work. Current failed pair stays missing; subsequent planned pairs stay NOT_RUN. Preserve original read times and observed_latency_ms for diagnostic comparison.

findings_fixed.issue: daemon_start_requested_ms was recorded before awaiting the initial heartbeat, up to a request timeout earlier than the actual daemon-start call.
findings_fixed.fix: Record this diagnostic immediately before startHostDaemon, after heartbeat readiness. Measurement clocks and fixture lifetime remain unchanged.

Timed observer loss: first formal pair missing, 99 later pairs NOT_RUN, warmup preserved.
Connection replaced and reopened before classification: same missing pair and retained measured timestamps; cannot restore pass.
verification_scope.prior_negative_witnesses: Owner mismatch, credential expiry, HTTP/refused/malformed/network ACK, sticky retry failure, in-flight cancellation join, log failure, offline/stale runtime, socket/daemon/gate teardown failures, denominator/correlation/statistics counterexamples.

reviewed_contracts: Public preparation gives 100 distinct account IDs; measurement fresh logins verify /api/me, 100 unique tokens and socket IDs, auth_ack+subscribe_ack and own-token readable issue, exact active participants.

Propagation serial formal writer k equals observer k; fixed5warmup/100formal, exact S+1 frame and own-token GET; BigInt versions, original arrival time, unknown writes cannot pass; 10000 denominator and infinity for all absent pairs.

Writeback uses same issue/100 observers, one warmup plus100formal, independent reading account, comment404 precheck, exact agent/comment/run attribution, separate business/finalization clocks and authoritative settled/proof/success/result endpoint.

Heartbeat uses enrolled actor0 mdt_, runtime_id/supports_batch_import payload, immediate readiness then15s after completion, request10s timeout, no reader credential, sticky error and stop/join before gate/log closure.
Owner runtime reads validate owner/workspace/daemon/runtime identity and status/last_seen outside metric clocks; offline pretrigger cannot become no_provider_launch or a valid sample.
Fixed150s freshness,5min daemon fixture,30s measurement deadline,2s/5s budgets, productdefault25pool and original r01 evidence retained.
